subject: Question about the recycling schedule
text:
Hi there,

I hope you don’t mind my asking, but I wanted to check whether you had a moment to look at the notes I left by the building entrance. I have been struggling to organize my seminar project around the neighborhood recycling pilot, and I realized I might have misunderstood the timing for the volunteer sign-up sheet. A helpful suggestion from you last week made me rethink how to present the results, especially the part about the collection bins being unavailable after six. If that is correct, I may need to ask our classmate group to collect photographs earlier in the evening rather than during the study block. That would not be impossible, though I would need to confirm access to the side courtyard with the office. Your earlier tip about bringing a portable lamp to the evening walk was very useful, so perhaps I can use the same approach for the final observation. If the sign-up table remains open through Friday, could you tell me whether it should list the new bin locations separately or simply refer people to the posted map? I can update the slide summary either way, but I do not want to confuse anyone if the schedule changes again this week.
